pages.title: Tensor Calculus Engine
pages.text: Computes in curved spacetime: Lorentz transformations, metrics, curvature and finally Einstein's field equations.$(br2)$(thing)Tier 3$() machine.

Note to self: a $(thing)tensor$() is an object whose components change in a precise way when you change coordinates, so the physics it describes does not. That is the whole trick of general relativity - write the laws in tensors, and every observer agrees on them.
$(thing)Made on the Extreme Assembly Table$() (it is also a crafting table). The recipe pages at the end of this entry - and JEI - show the pattern.

$(thing)Machine data$(): a single-block machine (5 item and 2 fluid inputs, 1 and 0 outputs).$(br2)$(thing)Makes$(): Einstein Field Core, Kerr Metric Shard, Lorentz Transform Crystal, Metric Tensor, Minkowski Lattice, Riemann Curvature Tensor.
